title: feat: Grid CSV/JSON export + Phase 10 L1 completion
body:
Phase 10 (Data Interaction Foundation) was the last v1.0 blocker. Four of five L1 features already existed (FileUpload, Lookup, ActionEngine, Server Metadata). Grid export was the missing piece.

### Code

- **`ObjectGridSchema.exportOptions`** — Added to type definition, mirroring `ListViewSchema.exportOptions`
- **`ObjectGrid` export toolbar** — Popover with CSV/JSON download, conditional on `schema.exportOptions`. Extracted `downloadFile()` and `escapeCsvValue()` helpers.

```tsx
<ObjectGrid
  schema={{
    type: 'object-grid',
    objectName: 'contacts',
    columns: ['name', 'email', 'status'],
    exportOptions: { formats: ['csv', 'json'] },
  }}
/>
```

### Tests

- 4 new tests covering: no button without config, button rendering, format dropdown, default formats
- All 128 grid tests passing

### Roadmap (`ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md`)

- Phase 10 L1: all 5 items → ✅ Done
- Phase 2/3: ⚠️ Partial → ✅ Complete (ActionEngine + Metadata API gaps closed)
- Beta milestone v0.8.0 marked complete
- Execution timeline progress bars updated
